site_name:
Malt Street Regeneration Site
Land Bounded By Bianca Road
Latona Road
Haymerle Road
Frensham Street And Malt Street
London SE1
description:
Application for Reserved Matters (scale, layout, landscaping, access and appearance) relating to Blocks B1, B2, B3 and B11 and all associated landscaping, car parking and ancillary works on land bounded by Glengall Road, Ossory Road, Bianca Road, Haymerle Road and Latona Road, London, SE1 and pursuant to Hybrid permission 17/AP/2773.

The proposals comprise the construction of 4 buildings ranging from 5 to 24 storeys in height (26.7m to 83.45m AOD), for 269 residential units, 4,128 sqm GEA of non-residential floorspace for retail, workspace and leisure (Use Classes A1-A4, B1c, D1 and D2), landscaping, new public realm, basement comprising parking and plant areas.
